population.arm_records: every authenticated final frozen assignment, including failed and harness-error outcomes

completed_shell_command_executions.trace_complete_when: every nonblank record is a JSON object with a nonempty string event type, every item.completed has an object item with a nonempty string item type, and the final event is turn.completed
completed_shell_command_executions.definition: item.completed records whose item.type is command_execution; not all tool families
completed_shell_command_executions.failed_calls_known_when: every completed command execution has a non-boolean integer exit_code
completed_shell_command_executions.output_bytes_known_when: every completed command execution has a string aggregated_output
completed_shell_command_executions.repeated_calls_known_when: every completed command execution has a string command
completed_shell_command_executions.command_normalization: collapse whitespace only; preserve case and punctuation

ctx_funnel.selected: length(selected_ids) after verified delivery or verified policy abstention
ctx_funnel.delivered: length(delivered_ids) after verified delivery; verified abstention is zero
ctx_funnel.semantic_use: length(used_ids) only when semantic_context_use_verified is true; verified abstention is zero

lifecycle.known_when: lifecycle digest is valid, actions end in session_end, session status is present, and final_loaded is empty

errors.harness_error: status is harness_error rather than passed or failed
errors.agent_nonzero_returncode: agent_returncode is a non-boolean integer and is not zero
errors.verifier_nonzero_returncode: verification_returncode is a non-boolean integer and is not zero
errors.overlap_policy: report independently; do not add categories

aggregation.paired_numeric: within frozen scenario and trial, include only pairs where both arm values are known; report median ctx-minus-baseline and lower/equal/higher counts
aggregation.paired_binary: within frozen scenario and trial, report the four boolean cells

publication.release_when: all 60 expected arm records are authenticated, sealed, unique, and present
publication.granularity: two whole-arm aggregates, whole-campaign pairs, and ctx-light funnel/lifecycle aggregates only

privacy.allow: fixed labels, fixed enums, aggregate counts, medians, and differences
deny: exceptions, incidents, stack traces, patches, tests, paths, or timestamps
